title: A Complete Turnkey Delivery Ecosystem
description: Prerana Architects & Associates eliminates traditional gaps between design concepts, local compliance, and structural execution. We deliver end-to-end transparency safely, on time, and within exact budgets.

services.label: Turnkey Project Delivery
services.teaser: Complete hassle-free management covering architectural blueprints, material procurement, site engineering, and final key handover under a single line of accountability.

pageDetails.heroSummary: Our flagship end-to-end construction model designed for clients who demand absolute precision, transparent material tracing, and zero structural budget overruns.
coreOfferings: Single-point coordination (Design + Procurement + Construction)
Fixed pricing models with zero hidden operational escalation clauses
Comprehensive milestone tracing and standard delivery reports
Complete coordination of materials, vendors, and workforce management
pageDetails.regionalCompliance: Includes complete assistance with local building regulations, site verification checks, and safety clearance processing.
